immutability_rule: Do not change models, omission sets, multiplicity families or retention rules after inspecting bias-control outcomes. A change requires a new contract version and preserved prior result.

primary_seasonal_and_taxon_omission.baseline: taxon-mean residualization of outcome and one climate predictor
primary_seasonal_and_taxon_omission.seasonal_adjustment: taxon-specific intercept plus sine and cosine of day-of-year residualization of both outcome and climate predictor
primary_seasonal_and_taxon_omission.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across 36 endpoint-component rows separately within each model-definition and omission scenario
outcome_blind_omission_set: each of the ten taxa with the largest observation count
the two largest taxa omitted jointly
strict_retention_rule: frozen baseline beta is reproduced within 0.00075
full-data seasonal-adjusted beta has the frozen sign
full-data seasonal-adjusted row has BH q < 0.05
every predeclared seasonal-adjusted top-taxon omission beta has the frozen sign
primary_seasonal_and_taxon_omission.claim_ceiling: Day-of-year adjustment is not developmental-stage classification. Passing does not close the anthesis-stage gate.

involucre_resolution.source_cohort: high-resolution auxiliary observations with positional accuracy <=10 km
involucre_resolution.model: within-taxon multivariable OLS with four CHELSA predictors, log head minimum dimension and log1p sharpness
strict_retention_rule: full-data adjusted BIO4 coefficient is positive
full-data adjusted BIO4 row has BH q < 0.05
BIO4 coefficient is positive in every resolution stratum with sufficient data

colour_negative_control.required_test: paired flower-versus-nonflower region by climate interaction; do not infer specificity from a nonsignificant control alone
controls: nonfloral green-pixel Lab lightness and chroma when enough pixels are present
colour_negative_control.claim_ceiling: The chroma-BIO12 claim remains blocked until this contrast is executed.

repeat_photo_variance.interpretation: within-observation between-photograph variance includes camera, lighting, viewpoint and possibly subject differences; it is not pure measurement error without manual same-individual verification

native_range.rule: Do not guess native status from coordinates or taxon names. Freeze an authority-backed region mask before rerunning.

external_validation.detector: complete the frozen 1,000-image independent bounding-box audit
external_validation.continuous_traits: stratified independent orientation, colour and outline reference measurements
external_validation.colour_note: human ordinal colour ranking cannot validate absolute CIELAB chroma
